preconditions_before_action.reason: The extracted BEFORE-facts (p_in_range_high_fee, p_out_of_range_low_fee, p_current_tick_spot, p_spot_manipulable, p_safe_mode_threshold) are all conditions of the protocol/attack setup and none is an observation of the attack's outcome; the fee-evasion result is kept as impact, not precondition.

claimed_required_property.reason: si_fee_reflects_range states the general rule that the fee should reflect the position's true In-Range status, but the formal plan's pattern narrows the condition to position_in_range=true AND current_tick_manipulated=true, i.e. only the manipulated-tick subcase, weakening the general requirement.

reported_bad_outcome.reason: i_fee_evasion (attacker pays 1 bps instead of intended 102 bps) is the direct harm and is captured; the broader yield-theft and invariant-bypass impacts are secondary.

formal_preconditions.reason: The plan encodes p_current_tick_spot as current_tick_manipulated=false and p_spot_manipulable as current_tick_manipulated=true, collapsing two distinct extracted facts into one repeated predicate, so one fact is no longer represented; the Safe Mode threshold is also left as an unquantified Boolean.

formal_required_property.reason: The relation obligation requires fee_charged_high=true and fee_charged_nominal=false under the manipulated-tick condition, which matches the report's intended high fee for a genuinely In-Range position, but the condition is narrowed to the manipulated subcase rather than the general true-In-Range rule.

formal_bad_outcome.reason: The formal impact i_fee_evasion is represented by fee_charged_nominal=true / fee_charged_high=false, matching the report's stated bad outcome of paying the minimal 1 bps fee instead of the intended 102 bps.

most_serious_defect: The formal plan collapses the distinct preconditions p_current_tick_spot and p_spot_manipulable into a single repeated current_tick_manipulated predicate, losing one extracted fact, and narrows the required property to the manipulated-tick subcase rather than the report's general rule that the fee reflect true In-Range status.
